design: Every exact authored family is retained, with a present plain donor from the same family and unchanged native corner rotations. No min/max pair reduction or inferred related donor.

One optional nearest RGBAF sampler: legacy W x H plane plus a second W x H plane only on maps with admitted junctions. First row keeps donor A/B, legacy guards/types and four vertex influence bits; alpha -3/-4 marks junctions. Extra row packs four 6-bit family IDs, four 2-bit corner indices plus 8 guard bits, and donor C/D + type. Exact integer-valued channels decode without +0.5.

A shared per-vertex influence field makes a bounded one-tile halo. The warped lookup consumes the entire neighbor family set. Plain art stays original; unsupported/path/unknown/invalid geometry receives the original-art guard. That guard also damps the warp before invalid support.

All active families compete using warped bilinear weights, family-seeded spatial noise and original donor texel luminance. Normalized positive shares blend colors and terrain traits. Continuous weighted material softness avoids top-two membership jumps. Unwarped and warped dominance preserve authored endpoints.

Generalized warp and material noise use a stable integer corner hash followed by smooth interpolation. Legacy FUNCTIONS remains byte-for-byte unchanged, including its noise; its SHA256 is ad3e029e56b4d0a3f00b0a37d493d0f4b054331d74f90d71c677c827bdf81f82.
Terrain, contact, footprints and color-cache receivers consume the same existing Field.source/bind interface; no extra sampler is introduced.

The new wrapper computes eligibility/blend once and evaluates the legacy pair sampler at one guarded call site only when influence is below one. Zero influence returns the legacy color and traits directly; partial influence uses the same weighted mix. Invalid/pure/metadata-missing fallbacks and input normalization remain exact.

Only junction-enabled terrain/contact source rewrites the exact four L/R/D/U relief calls to transition_relief_samples. An internal default 4 runtime loop preserves each original coordinate operator, dx/dy and local discarded traits. All downstream sum/min/max/height math stays unchanged. Pair-only source has no helper or rewrite.

Both transition_junction_materials and transition_relief_passes are private internal shader uniforms whose production defaults remain 4; no application writes or settings expose them. The shader uses these runtime bounds directly, avoiding known maxima that caused excessive GL expansion. At those owned defaults, every call processes exactly four material slots/four relief taps.
bounds_and_limits: At most four own-family donor samples per generalized call, plus the existing original-art sample. Full junction path uses four metadata fetches; partial halo may also evaluate the accepted pair branch. Existing painted-relief calls multiply these per-call costs, so complete viewport measurements remain required.

MAX_TILES remains 262144. Texture storage and retained PackedColorArray payload are each at most 32 bytes per tile (8 MiB apiece) when junctions exist, excluding temporary arrays and driver/RSS costs. Pair-only maps retain the prior one-plane allocation.

Analytical fixture validates metadata and topology; independent actual-shader GPU harness and original-art rendered fixtures are required for shader continuity, visible quality and composed receiver claims.
